tokenSaviorAgent.pythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Python executable used to launch the Agent-Platform backend.

tokenSaviorAgent.backend.enabled.description: Enable the Agent-Platform Python backend tool provider. Set to false to run the agent without any tool provider (direct-answer mode only).

tokenSaviorAgent.serviceModule.description: Python module path for the Token Savior internal service transport.

tokenSaviorAgent.modelProvider.description: Preferred model provider for future Token Savior orchestration.

tokenSaviorAgent.copilotModelFamily.description: Optional VS Code language model family selector for the Copilot-backed provider.

tokenSaviorAgent.copilotModelId.description: Optional exact VS Code language model id for the Copilot-backed provider.

tokenSaviorAgent.localModelLabel.description: Display label for the configured local model provider.

tokenSaviorAgent.localEndpoint.description: Base URL of the local model runtime (for Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible server).

tokenSaviorAgent.localModelName.description: Model name served by the local runtime, for example llama3.1:8b or mistral.

tokenSaviorAgent.localApiFormat.description: Protocol used by the local model runtime.

tokenSaviorAgent.localApiKey.description: Optional API key for an OpenAI-compatible local model endpoint.

tokenSaviorAgent.commandApprovalMode.description: Approval policy for project action commands.

tokenSaviorAgent.destructiveApprovalMode.description: Approval policy for destructive tools like checkpoint restore.

tokenSaviorAgent.autoSaveProjectMemory.description: Automatically save approved mutating workflow outcomes and eligible tool-backed preview runs to project memory.

tokenSaviorAgent.persistRunHistory.description: Persist recent preview runs in workspace state so they survive extension-host restarts.

tokenSaviorAgent.toolTimeoutMs.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Calls exceeding this are failed gracefully.

tokenSaviorAgent.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum token budget for context injected into planning prompts.

scripts.package:precheck: npm test && npm run test:extension-host && npm run test:mutation-e2e
scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); fs.mkdirSync('.artifacts',{recursive:true}); const out=path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','@vscode','vsce','vsce'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'package','--no-dependencies','--out',out],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run package && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const vsix=path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); if(!fs.existsSync(vsix)){console.error(`Missing VSIX artifact: ${vsix}`); process.exit(1);} console.log(`Dry-run artifact ready: ${vsix}`);"
scripts.publish:vsce: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const token=process.env.VSCE_PAT; if(!token){console.error('VSCE_PAT is required'); process.exit(1);} const packagePath=process.env.VSIX_PATH || path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','@vscode','vsce','vsce'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'publish','--packagePath',packagePath,'-p',token],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:ovsx: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const token=process.env.OVSX_PAT; if(!token){console.error('OVSX_PAT is required'); process.exit(1);} const packagePath=process.env.VSIX_PATH || path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','ovsx','bin','ovsx'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'publish',packagePath,'--pat',token],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
